_source.content_preview: Spring Boot Actuator provides production-ready features for your application. We will look at monitoring endpoints. This method is highly effective for checking application health, especially when using Spring Boot with Kubernetes. The goal of this Spring Boot guide is to monitor your services and that is how you monitor your Spring Boot application.

especially when using Spring Boot with Kubernetes.

_source.title: Understanding Spring Boot Profiles
_source.author: Alice Developer
_source.content_preview: Spring Boot Profiles allow you to manage configurations for different environments (dev, prod). This method is highly effective for separating concerns, especially when using Spring Boot with CI/CD pipelines. The goal of this Spring Boot guide is to manage environments effectively and that is how you manage your Spring Boot profiles.

_source.content_preview: Spring Boot Actuator provides production-ready features for your application. We will look at monitoring endpoints. This method is highly effective for checking application health, especially when using Spring Boot with Kubernetes. The goal of this Spring Boot guide is to monitor your services and that is how you monitor your Spring Boot application.

especially when using Spring Boot with Kubernetes.

_source.title: Understanding Spring Boot Profiles
_source.author: Alice Developer
_source.content_preview: Spring Boot Profiles allow you to manage configurations for different environments (dev, prod). This method is highly effective for separating concerns, especially when using Spring Boot with CI/CD pipelines. The goal of this Spring Boot guide is to manage environments effectively and that is how you manage your Spring Boot profiles.
